segments_en: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf proposed to me among a group of the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ proposed to me on behalf of his freed slave Usāmah ibn Zayd. I had been told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Whoever loves me, let him love Usāmah."
So when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke to me, I said: My affair is in your hands, so marry me to whomever you wish. He said:
"Go to Umm Sharīk."
Umm Sharīk was a wealthy woman of the Anṣār who spent generously in the cause of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and guests would stay with her. I said: I will do so. He said:

"Do not do that, for Umm Sharīk has many guests, and I dislike that your head covering should fall off you or the garment uncover your shins so that people see something of you that you would dislike. Rather, move to your cousin ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn Umm Maktūm."
He was a man of Banū Fihr, so I moved to him. (Abridged.)
label: machine translation

segments_en: When the waiting period of Zaynab ended, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Zayd: "Mention me to her."
Zayd said: So I went and said: O Zaynab, glad tidings! The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sent me to you, mentioning you [for marriage].
She said: I will not do anything until I consult my Lord. So she stood at her place of prayer, and the Qurʾān was revealed, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and entered without permission.

ibn Tamīm, that Abū Bashīr al-Anṣārī informed him that he

"No necklace of bowstring, or any necklace, is to remain on the neck of a camel without being cut off."

He said: We said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, do you fear for us, when we are between six hundred and seven hundred?
He said: "You do not know; perhaps you will be tested."

Kaʿb ibn Mālik, that the Prophet ﷺ would only return from a journey during the day.
Al-Ḥasan said: In the forenoon. When he returned from a journey, he would go to the mosque, pray two rakʿahs in it, and then sit in it.

segments_en: that

he set out with a companion of his to visit Abū Saʿīd during his illness. We left him and met a friend of ours who wanted to go in to see him, so we went and sat in the mosque. Then he came back and told us that he had heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Crawling creatures are among the jinn. Whoever sees something of them in his house should warn it three times to leave. If it returns, let him kill it, for it is a devil."

segments_en: I came to Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, and while I was sitting
with him, I heard something moving beneath
his bed. I looked and there was a snake, so I got up. Abū Saʿīd said, "What is the matter with you?" I said, "A snake is here."
He said, "What do you want to do?" I said, "Kill it."

He pointed to a room in his house opposite his own room and said, "A cousin of mine was in this room. On the day of al-Aḥzāb he asked permission to go to his family, and he was newly married. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave him permission and told him to take his weapon with him. He came to his house and found his wife standing at the door of the room, so he motioned to her with the spear. She said, 'Do not be hasty until you see what brought me out.'

He entered the room and there was a huge snake, so he stabbed it with the spear and went out with it impaled on the spear, writhing. I do not know which of them died more quickly, the man or the snake. His people came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'Pray to Allah to bring our companion back.' He said, 'Ask forgiveness for your companion.' Then he said:
'A group of the jinn accepted Islam in Medina. If you see any of them, warn it three times. Then if it appears to you after that, kill it after the three warnings.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about house snakes, and he said:
"If you see any of them in your dwellings, say: 'I ask you by the covenant that Noah took from you, I ask you by the covenant that Solomon took from you, not to harm us.' If they return, kill them."

segments_en: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, the Quraysh sat and spoke of their lineages among themselves, and they likened you to a palm tree growing in a low, filthy patch of ground." Then the Prophet ﷺ said:

"Indeed, Allah created creation and placed me among the best of them, from the best of their groups, and the best of the two groups. Then He chose the tribes and placed me in the best tribe. Then He chose the families and placed me in the best of their families. So I am the best of them in person and the best of them in lineage."
label: machine translation

segments_en: They said, "O Messenger of Allah, when did prophethood become established for you?" He said:
"While Adam was between the spirit and the body."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"I will be the first of people to come forth when they are resurrected, and I will be their spokesman when they come as a delegation, and I will be the bearer of good news to them when they despair. The banner of praise will be in my hand that day, and I am the most honored of the children of Adam before my Lord, and there is no boast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: May Allah be pleased with him, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"I am the first one from whom the earth will be split open, and I will be clothed in a garment from the garments of Paradise. Then I will stand at the right of the Throne, and none of creation will stand in that position except me."
He said: This is a ḥasan gharīb ṣaḥīḥ hadith.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Ask Allah for the wasīlah for me."
They said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the wasīlah?" He said:
"The highest rank in Paradise, which only one man will attain, and I hope that I am he."
He said: This is a gharīb hadith, and its chain of narration is not strong.
And Kaʿb is not well known, and we do not know anyone who narrated from him other than Layth ibn Abī Sulaym.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"My likeness among the prophets is like a man who built a house and made it good, complete, and beautiful, except for the place of one brick. The people began to go around the building, admiring it and saying, 'If only the place of that brick were completed.' And I am, among the prophets, the place of that brick."
And with this chain of narration, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said:
"When the Day of Resurrection comes, I will be the leader of the prophets, their spokesman, and the one entrusted with their intercession, without boasting."
label: machine translation

segments_en: Some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat waiting for him. He came out, and when he drew near them he heard them conversing, and he heard their discussion. One of them said, "It is amazing that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, took one of His creation as an intimate friend: He took Abraham as an intimate friend."
Another said, "Is that more amazing than the speech of Moses? Allah spoke to him directly." Another said, "And Jesus is the word of Allah and a spirit from Him."
Another said, "Adam was chosen by Allah." Then he came out to them, greeted them, and said:

"I have heard your words and your amazement that Abraham is the intimate friend of Allah, and he is so; and Moses is the one Allah confided in, and he is so; and Jesus is the spirit of Allah and His word, and he is so; and Adam was chosen by Allah, and he is so. Indeed, I am the beloved of Allah, and there is no boast. I am the bearer of the banner of praise on the Day of Resurrection, and there is no boast. I am the first intercessor and the first whose intercession is accepted on the Day of Resurrection, and there is no boast. I am the first to move the rings of the gate of Paradise, and Allah will open it for me and admit me into it, with the poor believers accompanying me, and there is no boast. And I am the most honored of the earlier and the later peoples, and there is no boast."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The description of Muhammad is written in the Torah, and [it says that] Jesus, son of Mary, will be buried with him.
He said: Abū Mawdūd said, "There remains a place for one grave in the chamber."

segments_en: I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were born in the Year of the Elephant.

ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān asked Qubāth ibn Ashyam, of the Banū Yaʿmar ibn Layth, "Are you older, or the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ is greater than I, but I am older than he in birth. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was born in the Year of the Elephant, and my mother carried me up to that place." He said, "And I saw the dung of the elephant, green and decayed."
label: machine translation

segments_en: During the Farewell Hajj, [the Prophet ﷺ said]:
"O people, which day is the most sacred?"
[He asked this] three times. They said: "The day of the Greater Hajj." He said:

"Indeed, your blood, your wealth, and your honor are sacred among you, like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this land of yours. Beware: no offender commits an offense except against himself; a father does not commit an offense against his son, nor a son against his father.

Beware: Satan has despaired of ever being worshipped in this land of yours, but he will be obeyed in some of the deeds you regard as insignificant, and he will be pleased with that. Beware: every bloodshed of the Pre-Islamic Era is abolished, and the first of it that I abolish is the blood of al-Ḥārith ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, who was being nursed among the Banū Layth when Hudhayl killed him. Beware: every usury of the Pre-Islamic Era is abolished. You have your capital; you do not wrong, and you are not wronged. Beware, O my nation, have I conveyed [the message]?"
[He asked this] three times. They said: "Yes." He said: "O Allah, bear witness," three times.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, while on his she-camel with the cut ears at ʿArafah, said:
"Do you know what day this is, what month this is, and what land this is?"
They said: "This is a sacred land, a sacred month, and a sacred day." He said:

"Beware: your wealth and your blood are sacred to you, like the sacredness of this month of yours, in this land of yours, on this day of yours. Beware: I will precede you to the Cistern, and I will boast of you before the nations, so do not blacken my face. Beware: I will rescue some people, and some people will be taken away from me, and I will say: 'My Lord, my companions!'
He will say: 'You do not know what they innovated after you.'"
label: machine translation

segments_en: I was sitting with Ibn ʿAbbās when a man came to him. [Ibn ʿAbbās] said: "Where have you come from?" He said: "From Zamzam."

[Ibn ʿAbbās] said: "Did you drink from it as is proper?" He said: "How?" He said: "When you drink from it, face the Kaʿbah, mention the name of Allah, breathe three times, and drink until you are fully satisfied. When you finish, praise Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
'Indeed, the sign between us and the hypocrites is that they do not drink their fill from Zamzam.'"
label: machine translation

say: I heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh
say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
"The water of Zamzam is for whatever it is drunk for."

segments_en: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for Hajj in three ways. Some of us entered ihram for Hajj and ʿUmrah together, some for Hajj alone, and some for ʿUmrah alone.

Whoever entered ihram for Hajj and ʿUmrah together did not come out of any of what was forbidden to him until he completed the rites of Hajj. Whoever entered ihram for Hajj alone did not come out of any of what was forbidden to him until he completed the rites of Hajj. And whoever entered ihram for ʿUmrah alone, then circumambulated the House and between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah, what had been forbidden to him became lawful until he would face [another] Hajj.
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Hajj three times: twice before he emigrated, and once after he emigrated from Medina. He combined ʿUmrah with his Hajj. What the Prophet ﷺ brought and what ʿAlī brought amounted to one hundred camels, among them a camel of Abū Jahl with a silver ring in its nose. The Prophet ﷺ slaughtered sixty-three with his own hand, and ʿAlī slaughtered the remainder.
It was said to him: "Who mentioned it?" He said: "Jaʿfar, from his father, from Jābir; and Ibn Abī Laylā, from al-Ḥakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn ʿAbbās."
label: machine translation

segments_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said regarding an ostrich egg destroyed by a person in ihram: "Its price."
